关于植物园的故事(A Story about the plant garden): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:大卫与本的经历和小计划。
David wants to be a doctor in the future. David hopes to visit London one day. David plays chess with Ben every Monday. Ants are hard-working insects.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike. David wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was snowy that day. Each family planted a sapling in spring.
Last Monday, David and Ben went to the plant garden. David thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like salad and milk. Sunlight filled the quiet room.
David borrowed a book about English from the gym. Ben is interested in reading. Life is full of small surprises.
